name: Bambu Lab A1

warn.ABS: Open frame: warps and cracks without an enclosure, and fumes go straight into the room. Not recommended.
warn.ASA: Open frame: warps without an enclosure and gives off fumes. Not recommended.
warn.PLA-CF: Abrasive: needs a hardened steel nozzle (the stock nozzle is stainless steel).
warn.PETG-CF: Abrasive: needs a hardened steel nozzle (the stock nozzle is stainless steel).
warn.PC: Open frame: warps badly; small parts only, with a brim.
warn.PA: Absorbs moisture fast, warps on an open frame; dry it and use a brim.

notes: Bed slinger: keep tall parts stable and low.

clearance_mm.note: Starting values per side, for PLA at 0.2 mm layers. Replace with tolerance-coupon measurements.

spec_note: Nominal build volume, included nozzle, hotend and bed limits checked against the first listed Bambu Lab document on 2026-11-20. Slicer exclusions, clearance values and optional transfer compatibility are separate from manufacturer hardware specifications.
